 Social Security Checks: Here’s When Your Payment Will Land in November
 2 min read Social Security recipients will see a change in November’s payment calendar, with some benefits arriving before the month begins and one group receiving payments a day earlier than usual because of a federal holiday. 
 The Social Security Administration’s 2026 schedule lists Oct. 30 for November’s Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payment, followed by Social Security payments on Nov. 3, 10, 18 and 25, depending on beneficiaries’ payment category and birth date. 
 November Payment Dates 
 SSI recipients will receive their November payment on Oct. 30 because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday. Under SSA rules, SSI payments are issued on the preceding eligible day when the first falls on a weekend or federal holiday. 
 Social Security beneficiaries who began receiving benefits before May 1997, or who receive both Social Security and SSI, are scheduled to receive their Social Security payment on Nov. 3. 
 For most other beneficiaries, payment dates depend on the birthday of the person whose earnings record the benefits are based on. Those born from the 1st through the 10th are scheduled to be paid on Nov. 10, a day earlier than the usual second Wednesday because Nov. 11 is Veterans Day. 
 Beneficiaries with birthdays from the 11th through the 20th are scheduled to receive payments on Nov. 18, while those born from the 21st through the 31st are scheduled for Nov. 25. 
 How The Schedule Works 
 The SSA staggers payments throughout the month. Beneficiaries covered by the birthday-based schedule generally receive payments on the second, third or fourth Wednesday, depending on whether the relevant birthday falls in the first, second or third group of the month. 
 The birthday used is that of the worker whose earnings record the benefits are based on, which may differ from the beneficiary’s own birthday. 
 What If Your Payment Is Late? 
 The SSA advises beneficiaries to allow three additional mailing days before contacting the agency if a payment does not arrive as scheduled. Recipients can also check payment information through their personal Social Security account. 
 For November, the key dates are Oct. 30 for SSI and Nov. 3, 10, 18 and 25 for Social Security payments. Disclaimer This content was partially produced with the help of AI tools and was reviewed and published by Benzinga editors.
